# OpenLim
> Remote Xcode, iOS simulators, Android emulators (+TV/Roku) for cloud agents. Source-available (FSL).

## When to use
- Cloud agent / CI with no Mac needs iOS build: `lim xcode build`.
- Agent needs to drive app: `lim ios create` / `lim android create`, then tap/type/ui-tree/screenshot/record.
- Share preview link + demo video on PR.

## How agents call OpenLim
- CLI: `npm i -g openlim`
- MCP: `openlim mcp` (stdio) or https://api.openlim.dev/mcp (HTTP)
- Skill: `skill/SKILL.md`
- API: `/openapi.json`, base https://api.openlim.dev
